subject: Your new account manager
text:
Hi Marcus,

I'm taking over your account from Luis, who's moved to the Southeast territory. I'd love to set up a quick call to learn what you need for 2027 and go over your account. Does Thursday work?

Best,
Tina Marsh
Account Manager, Acme Fasteners
label: ordinary
note: New account manager; 'account' is a customer relationship.
